method: Actual overlay executed in isolated Node VM with controlled delayed audio decoding and WebAudio lifecycle spies. No browser pixels or listening.

checks.name: One pending decode per ambient track
Disabling ambience cancels pending audio and cannot start a delayed loop
Hiding page during decode cannot start ambient audio
Enabled nearby fire and wet environment start two loops
Disabled ambience releases running sources and gain nodes
Native AudioContext replacement disposes old loops and reconnects new ones
Native sound switch cancels pending ambience before decode completes
Leaving wet region while decoding cannot play obsolete water ambience
Pending footstep is cancelled when footsteps disabled
Pending footstep is cancelled when scene changed
Walking schedules one footstep (old decode expired)
Pending footstep is cancelled when old decode expired
Walking schedules one footstep (audio context replaced)
Pending footstep is cancelled when audio context replaced
Valid walk still plays one native-routed footstep
Finished footsteps disconnect their source and gain
